name: radio
summary: One-of-many selection control. Use MRadioGroup with :options + v-model; as-button renders a segmented control. Standalone MRadio is unused.

buttonStyle.note: never set to outline in product (F2)

block.note: full-width segmented control — segments split the container width evenly (as-button).

anatomy: OR segmented buttons (a-radio-button, selected fills brand)

accessibility.semantics: native input type=radio grouped by name; Arrow keys move selection, Space selects
accessibility.label: give the group a field label or aria-label

decisionFlow: Pick exactly one from a few visible options? -> Radio.
[Radio style] Longer labels / vertical form field? -> radio list (default).
[Radio style] Alert severity filter (Critical/Major/Warning)? -> Severity switch (radio-toggle-shadow + alert-severity-buttons, as-button).
[Radio style] Each option clearer with an icon (view/mode toggle)? -> Segmented with icons (as-button + icon in option slot).
[Radio style] Otherwise small compact set (2-5)? -> plain segmented (as-button).

radio-list(default).useWhen: pick one of a few options with a vertical/inline list; longer labels OK

segmented(as-button).useWhen: a small set (2-5) of always-visible, mutually-exclusive choices; compact

segmented+icons.useWhen: segmented where each option reads better with an icon (icon via option slot; without-icon-margin context, 14x)

severity-switch.useWhen: borderless segmented with separators (real combo: radio-toggle-shadow + alert-severity-buttons, as-button)

disabled.useWhen: whole group not changeable; or option.disabled for one option

list.useWhen: Pick exactly one from a few options where labels may be longer, inside a form or settings panel — the default radio style, laid out vertically or inline. Used for form fields and mode choosers with descriptions.
list.dontUse: Don't use for a compact side-by-side toggle (use segmented), for multi-select (Checkbox), instant on/off (Switch), or more than ~6 options / tight space / needs search (DropdownPicker).
list.example: Severity Low / Medium / High on a form; a mode chooser with per-option descriptions.

segmented.useWhen: A small set (2-5) of always-visible, mutually-exclusive choices that benefit from being compact and side-by-side — rendered as joined buttons via as-button (255x). This is also the Button family's segmented control.
segmented.dontUse: Don't use for long labels or vertical form fields (use list), when each option needs an icon to be clear (use segmented-with-icons), for the alert-severity look (use severity-switch), or for >6 options (DropdownPicker).
segmented.example: Time range 1h / 24h / 7d / 30d and chart view toggles in the metric explorer toolbars and anomaly/forecast/outlier modals.

segmented-with-icons.useWhen: A segmented control where each segment reads better with an icon — view/mode toggles. Put the icon in the option slot (as-button + icon; without-icon-margin context, 14x).
segmented-with-icons.dontUse: Don't use when text labels alone are clear (plain segmented), for form fields with long labels (list), or for the borderless separator alert-severity look (severity-switch).

do: Use MRadioGroup with :options for one-of-many; v-model the value.
Use as-button for a small set of always-visible exclusive choices.
dont: Don't use radio for multi-select (Checkbox) or instant on/off (Switch).
Don't use radio for many options / tight space (DropdownPicker).
Don't render standalone MRadio — go through the group.
whenToUse: Choosing exactly one option from a small, visible set.
knownIssues: F1 (low): standalone MRadio + its variant=info/type=button are unused (0x); the group is the real API.
F2 (low): buttonStyle outline never used (always solid).
F3 (high, a11y): no visible focus indicator (SF-001).

F4 (medium): segmented selected style is context-dependent — standalone = kit .ant-radio-group-solid (navy #111c2c @0.8 opacity); inside form/panel contexts form.less overrides to solid --primary !important + 11px padding + icon spacing. Same markup renders the same in Storybook as the product; divergence is the missing form ancestor. Move the canonical segmented style into the component to make it consistent.

segmentedVariants.with-icons: icon per option via option slot (without-icon-margin, 14x)
segmentedVariants.severity-switch: radio-toggle-shadow + alert-severity-buttons + as-button (severity-switch.vue): borderless, separators, tinted rounded selected chip

changelog: 2026-07-21 — Added a `block` prop: a full-width segmented control (as-button) whose segments split the width evenly. Used by obs-user-menu for the Dark/Light/Auto theme switcher.
2026-06-07: added (decision-grade from the start). 225x; standalone MRadio 0x; as-button 255x. Verified list + segmented light/dark. F1-F3. Closes Button's segmented-control relative.
kitAccent: the selected list-dot is painted with Ant's @primary-color = cyan #099dd9 (both themes) — NOT --primary (navy). Not in variables.json; see tokens/kit-accents.json.
$tokensNote: Selected fill = --primary (#111c2c light / #e3e8f2 dark); the radio dot/check uses the kit Ant accent @primary-color (#099dd9, kit-accents.json), which is not in variables.json.

a11y.summary: Tab to the group, Arrow keys move selection; each option role=radio with label, shared name groups them. Selected segment = --primary fill.
a11y.$note: Catalogue-wide gap SF-001 = no visible :focus-visible ring; tracked in findings/.
